versions.content: VariationPointProxy vs. VariationPoint The differ- ence between a VariationPoint and a VariationPointProxy is that if during the process of binding the formula evaluates to 0 the VariationPointProxy re- mains in the model while the VariationPoint as well as its owner is removed from the model.
